description: This file is a PHP template file used for rendering the dashboard campaign configuration page within a project, including layout inclusion, sections, form handling, script behavior, and partial insertions.

methods.name: layout
methods.description: Sets the layout template for the page

methods.name: section
methods.description: Defines a content section within the template

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Includes a partial template in the current template

methods.name: supply
methods.description: Provides content for a named slot or placeholder

methods.name: form_form
methods.description: Generates a form element from the provided form object

methods.name: raw
methods.description: Outputs raw data or variables without escaping

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Closes or resets a section or buffer in the template
